shared_hosting.reason: No disposable commercial shared-hosting account; local Apache layout and private VPS fixtures do not certify that provider.

aws.reason: No authorized disposable AWS deployment; recipes are supplied, not provider-certified.

azure.reason: No authorized disposable Azure deployment; recipes require target validation.

docker_image.reason: No local Docker daemon; optional CI/manual image validation remains separate from source installation.

real_oidc.reason: No dedicated real identity-provider account/callback credentials; provider-neutral fixtures do not establish live-provider acceptance.

physical_passkeys.reason: Virtual WebAuthn verification is tested; physical security-key/platform authenticator ceremonies remain unverified.

other_mobile.reason: Only the Android 11 arm64 OpenGL synthetic lab was accepted; React Native, iOS, default rendering, production storage and background policies require their own targets.

manual_accessibility.reason: Automated browser/Axe/keyboard checks are available; no claim of completed assistive-technology or independent human accessibility audit.

independent_security.reason: Internal hardening and negative tests are not an independent security audit or compliance certification.

long_workloads.reason: Bounded lifecycle/crash fixtures do not certify multi-hour application-specific load, physical-host failover or operational SLOs.

model_quality.reason: Maintainer assigned model/provider quality evaluation to application authors; installed-model interoperability does not certify output quality.

os_tool_sandbox.reason: Tool callbacks/processes are for trusted code. An OS sandbox for arbitrary untrusted code is not provided or advertised.

packagist.reason: GitHub source and static Composer ZIP distribution are supported; Packagist registration and npm/PyPI/pub.dev publication are not claimed.
